annotations.title: List every task for one client

description: Whole-client view: every task in one client workspace, filtered and paged on the server. Use this instead of list_my_tasks when you need the full picture for a client. Defaults to open, un-parked work, 50 per page, in summary mode (id, title, status, assignee, project, deadline) plus counts by status.

parked.description: Parked tasks: exclude (default), include, or only.

status.description: Only these statuses. Default: open work (queued, assigned, in_progress, review, blocked, escalated).

summary.description: Summary rows (default true). Pass false for full task rows.

name: list_client_tasks
title: List every task for one client
